contract.subsets: uniform question subsets without replacement, sorted into source order; explicit indices stored
contract.ranking: descending mean reward, stable ties in original candidate order

nulls.pooled: independent candidate/question reward draws with replacement from all candidates
nulls.conditioned: independent draws with replacement within each fixed sigma group; preserves group counts and group/question sampling laws, including scale means

contract.global_selection: rank all N candidates jointly; never average the maxima of sigma groups
contract.uncertainty: observed transfer percentiles describe selection-subset variation with fixed candidates/holdout; null bands are replicate SD, not SEM
contract.permutations: full-pool top50 statistic; independent within-question permutations with exactly marginalized binary holdout hypergeometrics; plus-one p-values
